name: EOS Black
storyline:
Following the devastating war between the ancient gods and the King of Giants, hatred and resentment began to fester, eroding the very foundation of the earth. In a final act of grace, the Goddess sacrificed herself to bestow a blessing upon the world, giving rise to the "Arcana"—human heroes endowed with the power to purify corrupted souls.

Yet, peace remained a fleeting dream. Blood and the fires of war have once again consumed the continent. As an Arcana, you are summoned to embark on a journey of destiny.

On this path riddled with desire and greed, will you uphold justice, or succumb to the darkness? The choice is yours to command.
summary: "Eos Black" is a dark fantasy MMORPG published by DiGeam in Taiwan. Set in the wake of a cataclysmic war between ancient gods and the King of Giants, the land is slowly being consumed by lingering hatred and malice. Players will step into the shoes of the "Arcana," individuals gifted with the power of purification, to embark on a perilous journey.
